title: ORBIT BOARD v1.3.9: CONSTELLATION WEB & ERGONOMICS
summary: Orbit Board v1.3.9 is now available! Featuring the new Constellation Web typing effect, tuned bubble burst, compact language switcher, perfected Probhat layout ergonomics, and enhanced fonts.
highlights: 🌌 New Typing Effect: Constellation Web with radiating cyber threads and glowing Nothing Red nodes
🫧 Refined Bubble Burst: Calibrated to 20 Bauhaus micro-particles for crisp tactile feedback without visual clutter
🌐 Minimal Language Dialog: Dynamic wrap-content sizing with 20dp Bauhaus rounded corners
🇧🇩 Probhat Ergonomics: Long-press 'র' brings 'ড়' (center), '্র' (right), and 'র্' (left) for natural typing flow
🔤 Typography Polish: Full Agency FB font with lowercase support; Qurova numerals demo logo glitch resolved
⚡ Performance: 120Hz zero-allocation render loop for butter-smooth display responsiveness
🔒 100% Offline & Private: Zero network permissions, complete on-device keystroke privacy

title: VOICE TYPING: MICROPHONE PERMISSION
summary: Having trouble with Voice Typing or mic not responding? Please ensure Orbit Board has been granted Microphone permission in your device's App Info.
highlights: 🎙️ How to Grant: Long-press Orbit Board app icon on home screen -> App info -> Permissions -> Microphone -> Choose 'Allow only while using the app'
⚙️ Alternative: Open phone Settings -> Apps -> Orbit Board -> Permissions -> Enable Microphone
🔇 Click Sound Mute: Prefer silent voice typing? Go to Orbit Board Settings -> Typing -> Mute Voice Typing Sound
🔒 Private & Offline: Orbit Board is 100% offline. Voice data is processed entirely on-device and never transmitted
